2607.07422.title: InductWave: Inductive Multi-Hop Logical Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
2607.07422.paper_summary: Logical Multi-Hop Query Answering over Knowledge Graphs (KGs) can be formulated as querying, with an implicit completeness assumption. Current works mainly focus on Existential First Order Logic (EFO) queries. These EFO queries contain conjunction, disjunction, and negation operators. Most existing works employ transductive reasoning, meaning they are not capable of reasoning over entities unseen during training. In the real world, there is a resource scarcity, and we cannot train a model with all the nodes of a large KG. Hence, we propose InductWave, a wavelet-based inductive embedding method for logical query answering on large KGs. Here, the training graph consists of fewer nodes than the test graph. Our model performs on par with the baseline models while having half the number of message-passing layers. It outperforms all of them in most cases, with 75% of the layers. These fewer resource requirements enable us to evaluate InductWave on massive graphs, such as Wiki-KG. We test our model using extensive experiments across varying train-test graph proportions of the FB15k-(237) dataset, comparing it with the state-of-the-art models. The code and datasets for the model are available at https://github.com/kracr/inductwave/.
2607.07422.paper_summary_zh: 邏輯多跳查詢回答在知識圖譜 (KGs) 上可以被表述為查詢，並隱含著完整性假設。當前的研究主要集中在存在性一階邏輯 (EFO) 查詢上。這些 EFO 查詢包含合取、析取和否定運算符。大多數現有的研究採用傳導推理，這意味著它們無法對訓練期間未見過的實體進行推理。在現實世界中，資源稀缺，我們無法用大型 KG 的所有節點來訓練模型。因此，我們提出了 InductWave，一種基於小波的誘導嵌入方法，用於在大型 KG 上進行邏輯查詢回答。在這裡，訓練圖的節點數少於測試圖的節點數。我們的模型在性能上與基準模型相當，同時擁有一半的消息傳遞層數。在大多數情況下，它在 75% 的層數上超越了所有其他模型。這些較少的資源需求使我們能夠在大型圖上評估 InductWave，例如 Wiki-KG。我們使用廣泛的實驗來測試我們的模型，涵蓋 FB15k-(237) 數據集的不同訓練-測試圖比例，並將其與最先進的模型進行比較。模型的代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/kracr/inductwave/ 獲得。
